case.reference_definition: towing-tank EFD / benchmark value; relative error magnitudes are |R_T,model - R_T,ref| / R_T,ref

axes.Re: Reynolds number V Lpp / nu at full scale

case.provenance_note: Error/cost priors are order-of-magnitude literature priors, NOT fitted values: Holtrop & Mennen (1982)/Holtrop (1984) report few-per-cent residual scatter on the fitting set, larger out of sample; ITTC-1978 performance-prediction procedure with a measured form factor is quoted at 3-5 % on resistance; CFD RANS at grid-converged KCS-like settings shows 2-3 % on total resistance (Tokyo-2015 workshop level); towing-tank repeatability is about 0.5-1 % on total resistance. Facility/CPU costs are order-of-magnitude times (seconds), not prices. The engine treats all of these as injected data.

models.label: Holtrop-Mennen (1982) statistical regression

error_prior.provenance: few-per-cent residual scatter reported by Holtrop & Mennen (1982); 6 % median adopted for out-of-sample hulls

models.notes: cheapest admissible model; breaks down on unconventional sterns and outside the fitting envelope

models.label: ITTC-1978 performance prediction (measured form factor)

error_prior.provenance: ITTC 1978 procedure quoted at 3-5 % on resistance when a form factor is available

cost.provenance: requires resistance decomposition + form factor: seconds of CPU

models.notes: semi-empirical: inherits the parent-hull form factor

models.label: CFD RANS (k-omega SST, grid-converged)

error_prior.provenance: grid-converged RANS on KCS-like hulls: 2-3 % on total resistance (Tokyo-2015 workshop level)

cost.provenance: 2 h on an HPC partition; mesh-iteration variability

models.notes: turbulence-model error grows with separation (unconventional sterns)

models.label: EFD towing-tank campaign

error_prior.provenance: ITTC repeatability of total resistance measurements: 0.5-1 %; 1.2 % median adopted including scale effects

cost.provenance: two days of facility time including model set-up (order of magnitude)

models.notes: accuracy floor of the admissible set; the only model that can serve epsilon < 2 %

stratification_design.mispartition_probe: Cb above 0.75 (deliberately the wrong axis, used as a falsification probe for the stratification assumption)

truths.label: prior_consistent
truths.comment: control: realisations drawn from the registered priors themselves; accuracy must reproduce alpha=0.95 and the interval level 0.90

truths.label: deployment
truths.comment: out-of-sample deployment (primary): registered shapes 15 % optimistic, 12 % heavy-tail blow-ups, +35 % error growth in the high-Fn regime

truths.label: heteroscedastic_only
truths.comment: ablation: no heavy tail, but +70 % error growth in the high-Fn regime -- the case stratification is meant to repair

truths.label: heavy_tail_only
truths.comment: ablation: 15 % blow-ups, no regime growth -- stratification is expected NOT to help here (falsification probe of the method's own rationale)
